slides.text:
“i love you” is not intimacy.

posting photos together is
not intimacy.

knowing each other’s
passwords is not intimacy.
slides.notes: Full source contained without distortion on exact 1080x1350 ivory paper canvas.

slides.text:
intimacy is when you can
break down in front of him.

and he doesn’t say:
“calm down.”
“stop overreacting.”
“others have it worse.”

he just stays.
quietly.
while you fall apart.
slides.notes: Full source contained without distortion on exact 1080x1350 ivory paper canvas.

slides.text:
he doesn’t try to fix you.
he doesn’t lecture.
he doesn’t minimize.

he is there.
present.
holding space.
slides.notes: Full source contained without distortion on exact 1080x1350 ivory paper canvas.

slides.text:
intimacy is when you can say:
“i need help.”

and he doesn’t answer:
“you’re strong, you’ll handle it.”

he asks:
“what do you need right now?”

and then... he does it.
without reminders.
without keeping score.
slides.notes: Full source contained without distortion on exact 1080x1350 ivory paper canvas.

slides.text:
intimacy is when he knows your
darkness. your 3am anxiety.
your self-hate days. your wounds
you hide from everyone else.

and he doesn’t run. doesn’t turn
you into a “problem to solve.”
doesn’t disappear.

he stays.
in the dark.
with you.
slides.notes: Full source contained without distortion on exact 1080x1350 ivory paper canvas.

slides.text:
intimacy is when you don’t play a role.
not the “perfect girlfriend.”
not the “always positive” one.
not the “low maintenance” girl.

you’re real. messy. sometimes heavy.

and instead of “what’s wrong with
you?”

he says:
“i’m here. we can talk when you’re
ready.”
